dedupe_keys.name: openspaceglobal 1 19 m urban open space map of 169 megacities

description: OpenspaceGlobal is an urban open space map at 1.19 m resolution for 169 megacities, described in a 2025 Scientific Data paper by Fan and co-authors. It was produced with a deep learning method trained on a small set of manual annotations applied to optical remote sensing imagery, processing more than 8.5 TB of images and nearly 90 million crowdsourced geospatial polygons. Each city is one GeoTIFF tile, grouped in 62 country folders, with a label band: 1 park and green space, 2 outdoor sports space, 3 transport space, 4 water body space and 5 background. Coverage: 169 megacities on several continents. Access: product and user guide at Science Data Bank, code on GitHub. Licence: not read for the dataset; the article is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. Caveats: validation gave 79.13% overall accuracy and a kappa of 73.47%, so category errors are common at the pixel level. Simulation uses: detailed open space and green space layers for urban heat, runoff and public space access models in large cities. Related records: the SEDAC SDG 11.7.1 urban public space data and OpenStreetMap parks.
